retained.role: Government-contractor/public-works ERP exposing both a strong historical Measurement Book->RA Bill identity pattern and concrete authority-bypass/atomicity failures.
positive_evidence: Legacy MB billing requires APPROVED Measurement Book selection and unlinked MB state.
RunningBill.measurementBookId is unique on the legacy path, enforcing at most one Running Bill per MB.
Server-side MB/Running Bill item math recomputes quantity/rate/amount rather than trusting client totals.
Running Bill payment status is derived from received-vs-payable state rather than directly set by clients.
negative_evidence: MB approval is committed inside prisma.$transaction, then createRunningBillFromApprovedMB is called afterward; bill creation failure can leave APPROVED MB without the expected bill.
Current primary createRunningBillFromForm58 path explicitly states Measurement Book is no longer involved and bills directly from SiteBillItem master state.
Form 58 path therefore weakens any claim that measured/certified field evidence is an unbypassable authority prerequisite for billing.
retained.integration_rule: Use legacy MB identity/immutability mechanics as a positive donor, and current Form58/non-atomic approval behavior as adversarial fixtures. Do not treat the repository as production authority for approved-measurement->bill/payment proof.
retained.next_test: Construct a synthetic accepted-BOQ -> MB approval -> bill creation corpus with forced post-approval bill-create failure and a Form58 direct-billing bypass. CAP-042 should fail closed unless the exact authoritative measurement/approval edge is proven for the billed quantity.
